strings.en:
To be free is
to be cursed to be free.

--J.P. Sartre

La Gias, an underground world in another phase space within the Earth. Shu
Shirakawa is revived by Luozorl, an Archbishop of the Volkruss cult, which
worships the God of Destruction Volkruss. Heading with Gaen, sent from the
cult's headquarters, to Langran's capital to seize Princess Monica of the
Holy Kingdom of Langran as a sacrifice for Volkruss's revival, he spots a
surface machine fighting the Schtedonias Union army.

Albada Bairalin and Serena Recital of Team Jerba, the Earth Federation Army's
5th Special Ops PT Unit, are suddenly summoned to La Gias during Mission
Devil, a mission to confirm whether Shu survived the Shura Revolt. To
complete their mission, the two offer to travel with Shu, an apostate and a
wanted man in La Gias for the terror attack on Langran's capital.

Pursued by the Schtedonias army, Shu's group tries to break through and
leave the battle zone. To help them, Saphine Zeora Volkruss of the Volkruss
cult appears. Entering Bagonia's exclusive economic zone, Shu's group
meets a Bagonian mercenary unit on patrol, led by Thomas Pratt, a Neue DC
remnant summoned from the surface.

Shu's group heads to Langran's Baldia Province to gather intelligence and
sow confusion. They come across Yon Gebana, a Surface Dweller test pilot
of the Federation Army's Development and Testing Corps, chased by the
Schtedonias army. To replenish their spent ammo, they use Yon's intel to pin
down a Schtedonias mobile fortress with Granzon's Gravitron Cannon and
seize its supplies.

On the way to Baldia, the group meets Cian Argent, a Surface Dweller
mercenary of the Schtedonias army, and then a unit under General Kirkus of
the Kingdom of Langran, spearhead of its liberation, appears, turning it into
a three-way battle. On Shu's orders, Saphine and Serena infiltrate enemy
territory and learn where Princess Monica is held and that Prince Feil,
Langran's first heir, aims to retake the capital.

Returning to the hideout from a secret meeting with her old acquaintance,
Masoukishin pilot Huang Yang Long, Saphine runs into the Schtedonias army,
and Serena rushes to help. Elma, the autonomous Sabot who is Serena's
partner, sights a battleship that looks like the Federation's Steel Dragons.

Albada's pair acts as a decoy for Shu, drawing off the enemy units around
the church where Monica is held. Shu infiltrates the Schtedonias-held
church alone and manages to free the captive Princess Monica...

Fleeing the Schtedonias army, Shu meets the Steel Dragons and Masaki,
pilot of the Masoukishin Cybuster, who stir his memories. Just then, Kirkus's
mercenaries Araceli and Sleigh appear. Shu intercepts them with Albada's
pair, who come to his aid. Granting Monica's wish, Shu sets out to seize
Norse, the first Masouki Project prototype, which Schtedonias is about to
carry off.

Heading to Kusaka City in Ballantine Province, where Prince Tellius, third
heir to the Holy Kingdom of Langran and vital to reviving Volkruss, is hiding,
Shu is ambushed by Neue DC remnant Oleg Nazarov. Shu refuses his demand
to help rebuild the Neue DC.

Shu visits Prince Tellius, under Kirkus's protection, and tells him his power is
needed. Meanwhile, Albada's pair acts as a decoy, drawing Kirkus's Masouki
away from the camp. Pursuing Tellius as he is sent to Kirkus, Shu clashes with
Kirkus's army, and the reinforcements that arrive for Kirkus are the Steel
Dragons and Lüne Zoldark.

Prince Feil proposes an alliance with General Kirkus against Schtedonias, and
Kirkus names his condition: the coronation of Prince Tellius, third in line.
Together, Feil's and Kirkus's armies drive Schtedonias out of Langran, and
Prince Tellius's coronation is held. During it, Shu spots a Gadifor fleeing
Kirkus's headquarters...

Trusting Shu's words, Tellius runs away from General Kirkus. Shu orders him
to train to raise his magic power to the needed level. Meanwhile, Kirkus, who
meant to make Tellius a puppet and seize power, is exposed for using a
double at the coronation and chooses to fight Prince Feil. But Kirkus's army
loses the decisive battle for the capital to the Hagane group and is
cornered...

To turn the tide, General Kirkus deploys the Valsion Custom Type CF
summoned from the surface, and Oleg again blocks Shu's group on their way
to the Temple of Tiba to break Volkruss's seal. When Shu promises battles
against strong foes, Ahmad Hamdi, pilot of the Masouki Solgady, accepts
his offer to join.

Gaen grows suspicious of Shu, who broke the seal at the Temple of Tiba the
wrong way and doesn't hesitate to destroy the Afterimage of Volkruss it
summoned. At the Temple of Troia, where the last seal lies, Luozorl and the
Volkruss faithful greet Shu's group. As the ritual to revive Volkruss is held
in the temple, the faithful bare their fangs at Albada's pair, left outside...

Shu's true aim was to defeat Volkruss, who held him bound, and win his
freedom...

Volkruss, revived by Shu, is sent back to the underworld by the power of the
Neo Granzon. Meanwhile in La Gias, General Kirkus died fighting the Steel
Dragons, and Feil took the throne of the Kingdom of Langran, declared war
on the Schtedonias Union, and sought to unite La Gias by force, only to be
stopped by Masaki's group, who broke from him.

Albada and Serena return to the surface with Shu's group. Waiting for them
are the Meliores Esse, Ruina's artificial lifeforms, who seek the waves of
negative emotion from intelligent life to revive the King of Ruin. Meanwhile,
the Steel Dragons, back on the surface earlier, are hunted for the
President's murder by the Gaia Savers, led by Special Presidential Aide
Arteur Steinbeck.

To expose the plot of Arteur and Teiniquet Zezenan, commander of the
Guest, aliens targeting the Earth Sphere, the group goes up to Space. At
Shu's invitation, the Guest, the Gaia Savers, and Masaki's Masoukishin
pilots gather in one place. Meanwhile, Albada's pair, waiting to secure their
escape route, is attacked by a unit that suddenly teleports in.

To operate in Space, the group meets a transport managed by Yon, but the
Guest attack. Coming to help is Mekibos, one of the Inspector Commanders,
thought killed in the White Star assault, sent by the Zovorg Privy Council. The
Inspectors and the Guest, as Earth calls them, are Zovorg's two great
factions, the Wolga and the Zogal.

Mekibos aims to end the war between the Guest and Earth, and Yon was a
secret envoy sent to Earth to look into Zezenan's suspicious dealings with
the Granzon. At Granzon's heart is a "singularity," technology provided by
Zovorg, and Zezenan was scheming to shift its phase to make events occur
that never could otherwise.

As Operation Reconquista, to retake the Guest-held Moon, draws near, a film
of light and a giant structure appear over Earth, and an eagle-shaped unknown
approaches Shu's group. The Federation Army begins its attack on the Guest
occupying Heaven's Gate, and Rof, persuaded by Mekibos, withdraws from it.

Zezenan tries to silence Rof, who has met with Mekibos. Shu rescues Rof and
joins the Steel Dragons to settle things with Zezenan. Meanwhile, Albada's
pair heads to the Moon to free Mao Industries, the Personal Trooper maker.
There they meet Kinaha Sokonko, a mercenary of Golaikunru, a Zovorg war
merchant who colluded with Zezenan to profit from the Earth Sphere.

Shu defeats Zezenan and, with the Hiryu Custom, which is joining Operation
Icebreaker against Ruina in Antarctica, tries to break through the barrier
covering Earth.

Quepalok Namo, a Golaikunru mercenary, invades Heaven's Gate as a
foothold for conquering Earth and to silence Rof's group. Albada's pair
rushes to help but struggles against the super-large gunship Meckennoza.
To end the chain of battles, Shu hurries to the final battle with Golaikunru...

Quepalok falls before the Neo Granzon and Albada's pair, and the fighting comes
to an end...
